openDecisions.question: Which future governed completion outcomes and source types count, and does deliberate same-content submission under a new logical ID count?
openDecisions.recommendation: Count one server-accepted, typed complete logical check across approved message/URL/QR sources, independent of risk and payment basis; exclude partial/inconclusive/blocked/failed/pending; same-ID replay never counts. Count deliberate new-ID checks without retaining content fingerprints.

openDecisions.question: May governed recognition reuse the existing checks_1/checks_5/checks_20 IDs and current EN/ES catalog without adding unlock timestamps?
openDecisions.recommendation: Reuse exact existing IDs/thresholds/EN-ES strings and current progress response fields; add no per-result award or new timestamp field. Existing catalog presence is not new governed approval.

openDecisions.question: Specify compatible existing-route capability selection and owner/result/operation identity, atomic admission/completion fences, erased replay behavior and all-copy deletion without altering accounting/dedup.
openDecisions.recommendation: Version coordinated existing contracts and Android adapters before dispatch; do not add a guessed endpoint/header/response field or reinterpret old routes implicitly.

openDecisions.question: Approve exact new marker/progress/receipt fields and lifecycle, including invalidation/PITR/restore/account deletion; which existing approved purpose/lifetime covers each bridge record?
openDecisions.recommendation: No new retained store/copy now. Preserve original7-day governed deadline and existing legacy limits as separate facts. Propose minimum marker fields/deadline with erasure/restore proof before implementing; do not inherit120/90-day retention by analogy.
